1: #!/usr/bin/env node
2: // A dependency-free stand-in for eslint and prettier, so the Chapter 6 hooks
3: // have something real to run on a machine with no npm install.
4: // Checks: no tab indentation, no trailing whitespace, file ends in one newline.
5: import { readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
6: import { join } from 'node:path';
7: 
8: const fix = process.argv.includes('--fix');
9: const targets = process.argv.slice(2).filter((a) => !a.startsWith('--'));
10: 
11: function walk(dir) {
12:   return readdirSync(dir).flatMap((e) => {
13:     const p = join(dir, e);
14:     if (statSync(p).isDirectory()) return walk(p);
15:     return p.endsWith('.js') ? [p] : [];
16:   });
17: }
18: 
19: const files = targets.length ? targets : [...walk('src'), ...walk('tests')];
20: let problems = 0;
21: 
22: for (const f of files) {
23:   const before = readFileSync(f, 'utf8');
24:   let after = before.replace(/\t/g, '  ').replace(/[ \t]+$/gm, '');
25:   if (!after.endsWith('\n')) after += '\n';
26:   after = after.replace(/\n{3,}$/, '\n');
27:   if (after !== before) {
28:     if (fix) writeFileSync(f, after);
29:     else { console.error(`${f}: formatting`); problems += 1; }
30:   }
31: }
32: 
33: if (problems && !fix) {
34:   console.error(`${problems} file(s) need formatting. Run: npm run format`);
35:   process.exit(1);
36: }
37: console.log(fix ? `formatted ${files.length} file(s)` : `${files.length} file(s) clean`);

(End of file - total 37 lines)
</content>
